First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the FAB Moon & Stars Ride group ride

An evening social ride timed around the full moon. Falls Area Bicyclists runs it once a month in the warm season. The meeting spot changes, usually a brewery or restaurant. Bring lights.
